chain_words.nuance: quick to think and solve everyday problems
quick to understand, sometimes in a practical or cunning way
exceptionally good at thinking or creating ideas
having a natural talent far above the average

explanation: All five words describe good mental ability, but they rise in strength from ordinary quick thinking to a natural talent far above average.

usage_notes.difference: 'Smart' describes general good thinking; 'clever' suggests quick understanding and can also imply a sly or practical way of solving problems.
